{{Quote|I just received word of an incident that occurred in the Meridian sector early yesterday, standard time. The good news is that the light cruiser ''Soothfast'' engaged and destroyed an enemy vessel near Exodo II. The better news is that two Yuuzhan Vong who jettisoned in an escape pod were captured alive. But the intriguing news is that the captives have requested political asylum.|[[Dif Scaur]]|<ref name="AoCI:HT" />}}
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], a '''battle''' occurred near [[Exodo II]] that saw a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] ship destroyed, and the spy [[Elan]] "defect" to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="AoCI:HT" />
